Text overlays appear at the top of the frame. (3) A fair-skinned hand holds a green Aromase shampoo bottle against a white background. The hand is steady, showcasing the product packaging clearly. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the label details. Additional text overlays appear on the left, detailing ingredients and benefits. narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Problem Identification -> Recommended Solutions -> Problem Identification 2 -> Medical Solutions
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video provides a categorical guide for selecting hair care products based on specific scalp conditions. It differentiates between general oily dandruff (recommending Aromase and DRX) and medical-grade conditions like seborrheic dermatitis (recommending Nizoral and Ketoshine). The use of ingredient highlights like Piroctone Olamine and Ketoconazole adds technical credibility to the recommendations.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names and displays multiple brands of shampoo with detailed benefit lists, strongly suggesting a promotional or educational endorsement from a skincare brand (DRX).
